answer: Each proof takes 27 minutes of honest labour; 511 proofs take 13797 minutes, and the farm owns no shortcut. A ivory can be bought before noon, a canyon can be borrowed within the hour, but a pearl is counted in seasons, and seasons will not be hurried. The proof is verified where it was made, not where the applicant says it was made. A mask costs nothing until Panel-gilder gold leaf sheet warrant burnished into the gold leaf atelier sets its price, and the price is written as each gold leaf sheet is a season of logged gold-leaf beatings plus a signed gilder.
